# Die_to_Die_Protocol

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Standardized communication protocols (e.g., UCIe, BoW) that define the physical and logical layers for data exchange between chiplets within a package. Provides the standardized interface needed for TCC to implement topology-aware routing and in-network processing across heterogeneous chiplets.
